description: AgML is the AI Institute for Next Generation Food Systems' Python library for agricultural machine learning. It provides dataset loaders, processing tools and model workflows for image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation, including TensorFlow and PyTorch interfaces. Inputs are supported agricultural datasets and task settings; outputs are model-ready images, labels and training or evaluation results. Coverage varies by upstream dataset, not a fixed region or time interval. Public source is free under Apache-2.0, while individual datasets retain their stated terms. A limitation is that the current loader design differs from legacy examples, so users must match documentation to their installed version and check dataset-specific annotation conventions. The library can prepare crop-observation evidence for agricultural and food-supply simulation components, alongside yield data in CY-Bench (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). Its README provides installation and usage examples and links the supported dataset collection. This record covers the reusable library, not a claim that all hosted datasets share one licence. No images, trained weights or package environment were downloaded.
